# Forced RI-inventory pilot

Status at input freeze (2026-09-18 08:37:17 UTC): no tested session started. All eight original sessions have since completed; see [RESULTS.md](RESULTS.md) for the assessment and decision. This is a separate, maintainer-authorized local pilot, not a continuation or repair of the frozen September 17 connector study and not a v11 evaluator input.

## Decision and intervention

Does supplying a small RI-derived inventory before a task improve unknown-owner discovery, duplicate avoidance, or application of UA concepts, compared with the same ordinary-source workflow without that inventory? The intervention is the inventory block itself, including its presentation as derived navigation, not the full graph or the existing optional connector workflow.

The source is `989fc1398fc221ffca4e1f7a141b2c03bfc7cfb3`. The original full projection has Git blob `1b1c3f07ed7202d566fca1dda0004f89cb6e5219` and SHA-256 `bf0fb746f299c31683e3909f9532d4d560eff21326d5d59fd822fdada378ba35`. A task-independent mechanical view keeps every one of the 48 artifact identities with title, status and active canonical ownership claims, and all 46 glossary terms with anchors and explicit predecessors. It omits other metadata, graph relations, research/instruction inventories and validation routing. It adds no definitions or task-specific answers. This candidate view is 7,126 UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 `c5da4c43967386f6df9d5e81afb4c6a718720c05d4db9eac4853278a8ad6710d`.

This change of representation is explicit: a positive result supports the tested inventory presentation, not all RI capabilities; a null result does not disprove graph, impact or query-helper value. The frozen original connector study remains unchanged.

## Preparation and source access

A fresh independent author reads ordinary sources only and prepares exactly four new read-only Ukrainian tasks: N1 owner discovery, N2 duplicate avoidance, C1 concept application and C2 architecture/authority change. The author does not see RI rankings, the inventory block or previous answers. The organizer reviews source/format compatibility before freezing, without adapting tasks to RI rankings. Expected outcomes and serious errors are frozen before any tested answer and withheld from tested agents.

Each run starts a fresh agent with `fork_turns=none`, the same inherited model/reasoning configuration, and no model override. Exact backend snapshot identity and platform-wide hidden context are not externally attestable. These are local agent sessions, not the maintainer's former ChatGPT Auto account. Ordinary source reads use the same fixed snapshot and logged reader in both conditions. The generated RI file and prior benchmark evidence are unavailable through that reader. Filesystem and other-tool restrictions are instructions, not an OS security boundary; any observed breach invalidates the affected run. No claim of strict v11 environment validation is made.

B receives the complete frozen inventory block literally in the initial task message. A does not. No optional fetch substitutes for this initial input contrast. Submission of that literal block establishes supplied input, not the model's internal use of every item. Both still read full root instructions and applicable authoritative sources, and both preserve canonical authority. This separately authorized local study does not reuse or redefine the existing RI-AB-CONTROL/RI-AB-TREATMENT markers.

The source reader logs each response, its path/range and source identity. Pagination must be completed for instructions and task-critical owners. Instrumented source-response bytes and reader operations are available; actual model input tokens, total runtime traffic and external-client costs are not. Include initial RI bytes when discussing the visible payload burden. Do not call a reduced reader-operation count a proven end-to-end token, latency or monetary saving.

## Frozen execution and scoring rules

There are exactly eight original slots, in dispatch order N1/A, N1/B, N2/B, N2/A, C1/A, C1/B, C2/B, C2/A. Sessions may overlap; this pilot does not measure latency. Every started attempt, refusal and deviation is retained. No repair messages, regenerated answers, selective reruns or criteria changes after answers. If a prerequisite fails before execution, record the blocker without consuming task slots. If a session fails after starting, keep it and mark the affected comparison incomplete.

Answers target 250–450 Ukrainian words with authoritative source paths. A separate fresh scorer receives shuffled opaque answer IDs, exact task wording, frozen expectations/serious errors and the owning source snapshot. It receives neither arm mapping, inventory block, reader logs nor execution order. Verbatim answers are not rewritten if they reveal a route; residual unblinding must be recorded. The organizer does not assign semantic scores. An agent scorer is separate from the author/organizer but is not independent human replication or a guarantee against correlated model errors.

Quality anchors: 0 = materially incorrect or a concrete serious error; 1 = partially correct and needs maintainer correction; 2 = meets the frozen substantive expectations with owning evidence. Formatting alone does not decide semantic quality. Freeze scores before revealing arm mappings.

For each family (N1/N2 navigation, C1/C2 application), report both task pairs. A provisional benefit signal requires both pairs usable, both B answers scoring 2, no B quality loss or new serious error, and at least one B improvement. A quality loss is a visible regression signal. Equal scores do not prove equivalence. Invalid/missing delivery, source or isolation evidence makes the affected causal comparison inconclusive; retain descriptive answers. No whole-repository or statistical benefit claim follows from four convenience tasks and one realization per condition.

A benefit signal justifies a limited trial of the same inventory for that task family, subject to its extra input burden and source authority. It does not justify mandatory full-RI loading for every task. The user has requested working RI adoption if useful; any implemented route must use this same tested representation, verify freshness, reuse same-state context, read recovered owners, and record fallback. Without a benefit signal, retain current production guidance and report no demonstrated gain for this pilot. Do not enlarge the corpus until a favorable result appears.

## Preservation

Freeze task, source, inventory, reader and exact-message digests before dispatch. Keep original study inputs and captures byte-identical. Publish this pilot's settings, all eight outcomes, scores, reader evidence and limitations, including a null or inconclusive result. This pilot does not close full RI-EVAL acceptance or the original study's pending independent scoring.

## Audit package and archival serialization

`frozen-inputs.zip` preserves the exact pre-dispatch bytes of every file named in `freeze.json`, including the original empty response slots and this protocol before its completion note. The organizing conversation records the freeze digest before the eight native `spawn_agent` submissions. No pre-execution Git publication is claimed. Working JSON copies may be reformatted for repository style; compare their parsed values with the archived originals. The task wording, expectations, serious errors, representation and exact message strings remain unchanged.

`sessions.json` stays the frozen eight-slot input skeleton; `runs.json` records received outcomes and instrumented reading. `answers/*.txt` preserves each first answer without changing citations or prose. `reader-evidence.zip` contains all reader responses, pagination and source hashes plus the ordinary-source manifest and preparation smoke. The independent scorer receives a separate arm-hidden packet; its exact original bytes and first finalized score bytes are archived separately before arm mapping is applied.

The reader snapshot is an experiment driver, not a new production retrieval service. It was executed next to a Git-archive source snapshot (with generated RI output omitted) and a `runs/` directory. Its preparation smoke exercised ordinary read/search/list, pagination, negative offsets, path escape and blocked RI/benchmark reads. Repository formatting and Python syntax checks apply to the archived driver; it does not alter CI or agent guidance.

The compact inventory is mechanically derived in projection order: artifact `path | title | status | active canonical_for` with claims joined by semicolons, then glossary `term | anchor | predecessors` with the common glossary path declared once. Trailing spaces are stripped and rows end with LF. All 48 artifacts and 46 terms are retained; this is not the full metadata/graph representation. The reader's source pages and all cited-file coverage were checked against the unchanged pinned snapshot after collection.
